method: the matched alias printed rather than assumed equal to the registered form
reason:
A form that matches with a TRUNCATED alias, mine, from batch 42.

`technical.benchmark_relative_management` carried the heading spelling `Gestão de Carteiras de Renda Fixa em Relação a um Índice de Mercado (Benchmark)`. It matches — but the alias it reports is `…de Mercado (Benchmark`, without the closing parenthesis. The registered form and the reported span are not the same string, which silently violates the contract every downstream consumer assumes.

It surfaced because amendment 66 added `Estratégias de Gestão de Carteiras de Renda Fixa`, which put the two forms in the same probe sentence and made `test_the_longer_form_wins_wherever_a_shorter_one_could_preempt_it` compare them. The guard did exactly what it exists for: a form registered eight batches ago had been reporting a truncated span the whole time and nothing noticed until a new form happened to overlap it.

Removed rather than repaired here. The concept keeps its unparenthesised pref and the lowercase prose form added in amendment 61 — which is the wording that actually fires on the definition sentence — so removing the parenthesised heading spelling costs nothing measurable. Making a trailing `)` survive matching is a tokeniser change, and this session has no budget to re-sweep precision behind one.

operations.form: Gestão de Carteiras de Renda Fixa em Relação a um Índice de Mercado (Benchmark)
operations.why: Matches with a truncated alias, dropping the closing parenthesis. The concept keeps its pref and its prose form.
